landing.tagline: AI handles the work. You make the decisions.
landing.subTagline: BSNexus is the command layer for AI-native companies.

planning.title: Direction
planning.description: One chat per project. Tell BSNexus what to do — it turns each direction into a request.

live.title: Decisions & Brief
live.description: Resolve only the choices AI cannot make alone. The brief tells you what shipped, what is blocked, and what needs you.

workers.title: Verified Deliverables
workers.description: Outputs ship with proof — verification command, exit code, and artifact links. No proof, no "shipped".

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Decisions that need you, the latest brief, and shipped work — all in one place. Hit "New project" to scope a new direction.

project.title: Project
project.description: Each project has four surfaces. Direction is a single chat where you tell BSNexus what to do. Progress shows the deliverable timeline. Decisions is the approval inbox. Inside (optional) opens execution runs and composition snapshots for debugging.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Connect BSage, BSGateway, and BSupervisor, and register the LLM executors that run your work. API keys are encrypted at rest — only whether a key is present is ever returned.

default.title: BSNexus
default.description: BSNexus is the command layer for AI-native companies. You direct, decide, and review. AI handles the work.
